stem: Triangle \(ABC\) is similar to triangle \(DEF\), where \(A\), \(B\), and \(C\) correspond to \(D\), \(E\), and \(F\), respectively. \(AB = 4\), \(BC = 5\), and \(DE = 12\). What is the length of \(\overline{EF}\)?
solution: Corresponding sides of similar triangles are proportional. The scale factor from \(ABC\) to \(DEF\) is \(\frac{DE}{AB} = \frac{12}{4} = 3\).
verify:
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert abs(d('A','B')-4)<0.01 and abs(d('B','C')-5)<0.01 and abs(d('D','E')-12)<0.01
ans=Rational(12,4)*5
assert abs(d('E','F')-ans)<0.01 and abs(ang('A','B','C')-ang('D','E','F'))<0.1
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==ans==15
